The refuter was correct that the old statement failed on edgeless graphs and that the old proof chose A = N(v), giving the wrong size direction. The live lemma now matches the conditional source claim with the missing hypotheses restored.

The refuter was correct that the cited maximal-blockade lemma did not yield the old conclusion 2. The live item now records the exact source iterative lemma instead of that unsupported local contradiction.

The refuter was correct that the old proof never derived the claimed co-P_5 obstruction from the written data. The live item now states the exact source dichotomy between deeper sparsification and few mixed blocks.
The refuter was correct that the old statement allowed r = 0, where the star expansion of P_1 is only a three-vertex path. The live lemma now requires r >= 1.
The refuter was correct that the old proof only handled cycles of length at least five. The live theorem is now narrowed to that exact range.

The refuter was correct that the old proof never established the total induced-copy bound required by the bounded-degree corollary. The live item now records the exact source theorem rather than that unsupported local derivation.

The refuter was correct that the old induction could not force whichever complete or anticomplete pure pair a chosen cograph decomposition wanted. The live theorem now uses the exact source cograph-pattern alternative instead of the overstrong arbitrary-cograph form.

The refuter was correct that the old theorem failed on tiny graphs because it omitted the source threshold hypotheses. The live statement now includes the exact small-x and large-order assumptions from the source theorem.

The refuter was correct that the reader repair still undercounted the upper repeated-variable subtree by one level. The live theorem now uses p = 2^(m+1) + 1, so the height convention and the bound |vwx| < p finally agree.

The refuter was correct that the old definition quantified over raw binary inputs that were not machine inputs under the chosen coding. The live definition now encodes machine-alphabet words into binary before pairing them with the machine code.

The refuter was correct that the old counterexample used an invalid input symbol 0. The live counterexample now uses the empty-alphabet looping machine on its unique input epsilon and the encoded pair <code(M_loop), widehat epsilon>.

The refuter was correct that the old false-statement refutation relied on the same invalid raw input witness. The live refutation now uses the encoded empty-input witness under the corrected universal-machine definition.
The refuter was correct that the old linear-space bound dropped the unavoidable +1 cell at w = epsilon and t = 0. The live lemma now carries |w| + t + 1 through both the space and time bounds.
